limits: Only source-commit evidence blobs are tiered; any untracked evidence is explicitly listed and must not be removed.
Only active maintenance test/tool/eval dependencies pin historical code; other historical runners and snapshots require cold restoration before replay.
Markdown parser covers inline links, reference definitions, and HTML href/src; malformed Markdown, runtime-generated paths, and backtick prose are not a complete executable dependency graph.
Case/fixture/task/prompt JSON referenced files are protected. Provenance-only JSON manifests do not pin raw outputs; original paths remain available through cold catalog/restoration.
Classification was static; the migration, ZIP verification and Git-blob restoration checks were subsequently executed. Historical model and host runs were not replayed.
